rules.name: moveAdmin1 UA-43
rules.description: Crimea shown as part of Ukraine (UN General Assembly resolution 68/262)
rules.reason: UN practice (owner's decision Q3, applied to EarthWatch3D by Plan 2b ruling B-7, as in EarthRelief3D): UN General Assembly resolution 68/262 of 27 March 2014, Territorial integrity of Ukraine. Natural Earth's default admin-0 file draws Crimea and Sevastopol in Russia; their admin-1 polygons (UA-43, UA-40) move to Ukraine and the Perekop line, now internal, goes.
